weapon.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range. If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally and deals damage to foe using a Special, restores 30% of unit's maximum HP. (Triggers even if 0 damage is dealt.) If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

a.d: Neutralizes "effective against flying" bonuses. If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP = 100% at start of combat, inflicts Atk/Res-6 on foe and grants Special cooldown charge +1 per foe's attack during combat. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack. Special cooldown charge granted even if foe’s attack deals 0 damage.)

b.d: If unit's HP = 100% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 75% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 50% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

c.d: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk/Spd+4 to dragon allies within 2 spaces during combat.
